subject: SOC 2 Type II attestation kickoff & audit-window clarification for Greenline Health
messages:
From: Maya Singh <maya.singh@greenlinehealth.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Dan Cho <dan.cho@greenlinehealth.com>, procurement@greenlinehealth.com
Date: Wed, 21 Apr 2027 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: SOC 2 Type II evidence and attestation request (Greenline PO gating)

Hi Karthik —

Hope you’re well. Procurement is holding the PO for the integration until we receive the final SOC 2 Type II report for the period ending Mar 31, 2027, or an interim attestation acceptable to our security team. Attached is our standard security questionnaire and the procurement gating checklist.

Two asks to unblock the PO quickly:
1) Can you confirm whether Redwood can provide an interim attestation or bridge that covers the missing audit window (Jan–Mar 2027)?
2) If so, can you provide a short evidence manifest (list of artifacts + expected delivery dates) so we can move procurement forward while you finalize the Type II report?

We’re targeting a PO execution by Friday, Apr 23. Please advise what you can commit to and by when — even a one-page attestation would help.

Thanks,
Maya
Maya Singh
Senior Procurement Manager
Greenline Health
Attachments: Greenline_Security_Questionnaire.pdf, Greenline_PO_Checklist.xlsx
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Maya Singh <maya.singh@greenlinehealth.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Apr 2027 10:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 Type II evidence and attestation request (Greenline PO gating)

Maya —

Appreciate the clear asks and the timeline. Short answer: yes, we can provide an interim attestation to cover Jan–Mar 2027 and an evidence manifest with delivery targets. I’m looping in Laura and Marissa for procurement and contracts support.

Plan we propose:
- Today: Security to produce a one-page interim attestation (signed by our CISO) and an initial evidence manifest.
- Thu morning (Apr 22): Delivery of draft attestation + evidence CSV for Greenline review.
- Thu afternoon: Legal/Procurement finalizes PO language using the attestation as gating evidence.

Marissa/Laura — can you prioritize contract redlines and confirm any wording constraints for an interim attestation?

Maya — I’ve also looped in our security lead for the attestation delivery. If we hit any gaps, we’ll provide a time-boxed remediation plan with dates.

—Karthik
VP, Sales
Redwood Inference
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Apr 2027 13:07:00 -07:00
Subject: Draft interim attestation + evidence manifest (internal)

Team —

Attached: redwood_interim_attestation_draft_v1.docx and evidence_manifest_initial.csv. Key notes:
- Attestation covers operating effectiveness through 2027-03-31 for the control domains Greenline flagged. It is time-boxed and references the forthcoming Type II report (expected delivery 2027-06-15).
- Evidence manifest lists artifacts we can produce in the next 72 hours (SOC control descriptions, sample logs, access review report, encryption config screenshots). Delivery column has committed dates.
- Two known gaps: (1) Continuous monitoring automated screenshot exports — requires a developer export (ETA 48h). (2) Fully compiled SOC auditor report (Type II final) — ETA as above.

I recommend we sign the attestation using a delegated security signatory (CISO is on travel until tomorrow afternoon). Vivek: can you OK delegated signatory for this instance (we’ll escalate for formal signature ASAP)?

I will sanitize the evidence artifacts for external sharing (redact internal hostnames) before sending.

-Neha
Head, Security & Compliance (acting)
Redwood Inference
Attachments: redwood_interim_attestation_draft_v1.docx, evidence_manifest_initial.csv
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Apr 2027 08:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Draft interim attestation + evidence manifest (internal)

All —

OK to proceed with delegated signatory for the one-page interim attestation. Conditions: 1) Evidence manifest must include delivery dates and point owner; 2) Any screenshots must be redacted (PII/hostnames); 3) We include explicit language that this is not a substitute for the final SOC 2 Type II report and that the final auditor report will be delivered by 2027-06-15.

Neha — please apply the redaction checklist and send external draft to Karthik for one last commercial review. Marissa/Laura — confirm procurement will accept a signed interim attestation as gating evidence (we may need a short rider in the PO).

Vivek
Head of Sales Engineering (acting)
Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Maya Singh <maya.singh@greenlinehealth.com>
Cc: Dan Cho <dan.cho@greenlinehealth.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Apr 2027 11:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Interim attestation & evidence manifest (Greenline PO)

Maya —

Thanks for the quick alignment. Attached is our one-page interim attestation (signed by delegated security signatory) and the initial evidence manifest with owners and delivery dates. Highlights:
- Interim attestation explicitly covers control operation up to 2027-03-31 and references delivery of the final Type II report by 2027-06-15.
- Evidence manifest includes: access review (Apr 23), sample encrypted storage config (Apr 23), redacted audit logs (Apr 24), and policy docs (immediately).
- Known items pending: auditor final report and automated monitoring exports (both have committed dates in the manifest).

Please confirm if this package satisfies procurement gating so we can proceed with PO execution. If Dan or your security team need any narrow clarifications, we can set a 30-minute call today.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
VP, Sales
Redwood Inference
Attachments: redwood_interim_attestation_signed.pdf, evidence_manifest_initial.csv
